notes.sowing: Buy fresh seed every year, as it loses vigor after one season. Sow {cm:1.3} deep from 2 weeks before your last frost, three seeds every {cm:15}. Seedlings take 2 to 4 weeks to appear, and come up fastest once the soil is near {c:12}.
notes.care: Thin to the strongest seedling at each station. Parsnips grow a long taproot and do not transplant. Keep the row moist and weeded while the slow seedlings establish, and water in long dry spells.
notes.harvest: Dig after the first few hard frosts, which turn starch to sugar. Roots can stay in the ground through winter under mulch; lift them before new growth starts in spring.
